title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Pagani Utopia
description:
Before one single Pagani Utopia reached a customer, the company built eight complete prototypes, twelve scale models, and spent more than six years on the project. Three of those prototypes existed only to test the engine, for about two years. And the result is a car that, by its maker's own words, has no hybrid system and no dual-clutch gearbox. This is the Pagani Utopia, and there are two things about it that you probably did not know. The first is about a gearbox that almost nobody asked a carmaker for in the twenty twenties, and why Pagani built it anyway. The second is about what is hiding inside the carbon structure, where one car contains more than forty different recipes of material. Both are verified in published sources, and we will show you where.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
